name: data-story
description: Source-grounded visual stories from CSV, spreadsheets, reports, and PDFs.
default_hook: Lead with the comparison or change that alters a decision.
emotional_promise: Turn raw evidence into a clear, defensible takeaway.
visual_world: Data structures translated into spatial, legible evidence.
lighting: High-contrast analytic surfaces with restrained depth.
materials: Charts, grids, labels, and evidence-linked source textures.
